title: Performance Optimization
description: Optimize Redis performance: pipelining, Lua scripting, connection pooling, memory optimization, benchmarking, and common pitfalls.
longDescription: When Redis becomes a bottleneck, optimization techniques unlock higher throughput. This module covers pipelining, Lua scripts, connection pooling, memory tuning, benchmarking, and anti-patterns to avoid.
whatYouLearn: Use pipelining to reduce round trips
Write Lua scripts for atomic operations
Optimize memory usage and key designs
Identify and fix common performance pitfalls
